Query/clarification dates are never accepted as submission deadlines. Missing/ambiguous submission evidence remains review-required before FINAL_SUPER_GREEN.

certifications_partner.text: cago Soft MVS/QuickRef Maintenance The Department of the Interior (DOI), Interior Business Center (IBC), Acquisition Services Directorate (AQD), intends to award a firm-fixed-price purchase order on a sole-source basis to Chicago Soft, Ltd., White River Junction, Vermont, for continued maintenance and support of DOI's existing MVS/QuickRef software. MVS/QuickRef provides DOI personnel access to programming and technical information supporting z/OS, OS/390, and MVS environments. DOI's current maintenance order expires September 29, 2026. Chicago Soft, Ltd. is the proprietary provider of MVS/QuickRef maintenance and software updates and has no authorized resellers. Accordingly, the Government has determined that Chicago Soft is the only source capable of providing the required maintenance. The Government intends to solicit a quotation directly from Chicago Soft and issue a firm-fixed-price purchase order using the simplified procedures at FAR 12.201-1. Award is anticipated by September 28, 2026. NAICS: 541519 – Other Computer Related Services PSC: 7E20 - IT and Telecom – End User: Conferencing, AV, Helpdesk, Deskside Support, Workspace, Printers, Collaboration and Productivity Tools (Hardware and Perpetual License Software) This notice is not a request for competitive quotations.
